name: gmdtool Runtime Bridge
description: Opt-in localhost runtime bridge, GitHub Releases auto-updates, and experimental background pause controls.

enabled.name: Enable local API (restart required)
enabled.description: Start a 127.0.0.1 server on port 18731 for Python gmdtool.

auto-update.name: Check for updates automatically
auto-update.description: Check on startup, main-menu entry and Geode mod-list activity (30-second throttle); idle menu backup every five minutes. Download and verify a newer public release, then offer Restart.

allow-background-play.name: Allow background level play (experimental)
allow-background-play.description: Opt in to the authenticated background_control pause bypass. Other pause mods may conflict; does not keep a minimized game loop running. Default off.
